title: Artists' Imaginations
description: ARTISTS' IMAGINATIONS can unleash some beguiling, if strange concepts. Wojtek Siudmak (front) has used near photo-realism on Obi-Wan Kenobi and the two droids, though his Leia is considerably more statuesque and his Luke substantially more muscular than the actual characters. The real fun comes in his ethereal landscape and his shattering Death Star with Darth Vader at the core. A more commercial design (rear) makes a point—literally.
